summaries.zh: RTK command rewriting suggestions + tool output compaction for DSH. Suggests rtk-rewritten bash commands (deny-mode under rewrite) and compacts noisy tool output (bash/grep/read) to reduce context usage. Port of pi-rtk-optimizer for the Pi coding agent.
summaries.en: RTK command rewriting suggestions + tool output compaction for DSH. Suggests rtk-rewritten bash commands (deny-mode under rewrite) and compacts noisy tool output (bash/grep/read) to reduce context usage. Port of pi-rtk-optimizer for the Pi coding agent.
